paragraphs.text: 1. AGNI advances with his lofty banner: the Bull is bellowing to the earth and heavens.
paragraphs.original: प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ।
paragraphs.translit: pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti |

paragraphs.text: He hath attained the sky's supremest limits. the Steer hath waxen in the lap of waters.
2. The Bull, the youngling with the hump, hath frolicked, the strong and never-ceasing Calf hath bellowed.
paragraphs.original: मुमोद गर्भो वृषभः ककुद्मानस्रेमा वत्सः शिमीवाँ अरावीत् ।
paragraphs.translit: mumoda garbho vṛṣabhaḥ kakudmānasremā vatsaḥ śimīvām̐ arāvīt |

paragraphs.text: Bringing our offerings to the God's assembly, he moves as Chief in his own dwelling-places.
paragraphs.original: स देवतात्युद्यतानि कृण्वन्स्वेषु क्षयेषु प्रथमो जिगाति
paragraphs.translit: sa devatātyudyatāni kṛṇvansveṣu kṣayeṣu prathamo jigāti

paragraphs.text: 3. Him who hath grasped his Parents' head, they stablished at sacrifice a wave of heavenly lustre.
paragraphs.original: आ यो मूर्धानं पित्रोररब्ध न्यध्वरे दधिरे सूरो अर्णः ।
paragraphs.translit: ā yo mūrdhānaṃ pitrorarabdha nyadhvare dadhire sūro arṇaḥ |

paragraphs.text: In his swift flight the red Dawns borne by horses refresh their bodies in the home of Order.
paragraphs.original: अस्य पत्मन्नरुषीरश्वबुध्ना ऋतस्य योनौ तन्वो जुषन्त
paragraphs.translit: asya patmannaruṣīraśvabudhnā ṛtasya yonau tanvo juṣanta

paragraphs.text: 4. For, Vasu thou precedest every Morning, and still hast been the Twins' illuminator.
paragraphs.original: उषौषो हि वसो अग्रमेषि त्वं यमयोरभवो विभावा ।
paragraphs.translit: uṣauṣo hi vaso agrameṣi tvaṃ yamayorabhavo vibhāvā |

paragraphs.text: For sacrifice, seven places thou retainest while for thine own self thou engenderest Mitra.
paragraphs.original: ऋताय सप्त दधिषे पदानि जनयन्मित्रं तन्वे स्वायै
paragraphs.translit: ṛtāya sapta dadhiṣe padāni janayanmitraṃ tanve svāyai

paragraphs.text: 5. Thou art the Eye and Guard of mighty Order, and Varuna when to sacrifice thou comest.
paragraphs.original: भुवश्चक्षुर्मह ऋतस्य गोपा भुवो वरुणो यदृताय वेषि ।
paragraphs.translit: bhuvaścakṣurmaha ṛtasya gopā bhuvo varuṇo yadṛtāya veṣi |

paragraphs.text: Thou art the Waters' Child O Jatavedas, envoy of him whose offering thou acceptest.
paragraphs.original: भुवो अपां नपाज्जातवेदो भुवो दूतो यस्य हव्यं जुजोषः
paragraphs.translit: bhuvo apāṃ napājjātavedo bhuvo dūto yasya havyaṃ jujoṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Thou art the Leader of the rite and region, to which with thine auspicious teams thou leadest,
paragraphs.original: भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसे शिवाभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblationbearer, Agni.
paragraphs.original: दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे स्वर्षां जिह्वामग्ने चकृषे हव्यवाहम्
paragraphs.translit: divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham

paragraphs.text: 7. Through his wise insight Trita in the cavern, seeking as ever the Chief Sire's intention,
paragraphs.original: अस्य त्रितः क्रतुना वव्रे अन्तरिच्छन्धीतिं पितुरेवैः परस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: asya tritaḥ kratunā vavre antaricchandhītiṃ piturevaiḥ parasya |

paragraphs.text: Carefully tended in his Parents' bosom, calling the weapons kin, goes forth to combat.
paragraphs.original: सचस्यमानः पित्रोरुपस्थे जामि ब्रुवाण आयुधानि वेति
paragraphs.translit: sacasyamānaḥ pitrorupasthe jāmi bruvāṇa āyudhāni veti

paragraphs.text: 8. Well-skilled to use the weapons of his Father, Aptya, urged on by Indra, fought the battle.
Then Trita slew the foe seven-rayed, three-headed, and freed the cattle of the Son of Tvastar.
paragraphs.original: त्रिशीर्षाणं सप्तरश्मिं जघन्वान्त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिन्निः ससृजे त्रितो गाः
paragraphs.translit: triśīrṣāṇaṃ saptaraśmiṃ jaghanvāntvāṣṭrasya cinniḥ sasṛje trito gāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Lord of the brave, Indra cleft him in pieces who sought to gain much strength and deemed him mighty.
He smote his three heads from his body, seizing the cattle of the omniform Son of Tvastar.
paragraphs.original: त्वाष्ट्रस्य चिद्विश्वरूपस्य गोनामाचक्राणस्त्रीणि शीर्षा परा वर्क्
paragraphs.translit: tvāṣṭrasya cidviśvarūpasya gonāmācakrāṇastrīṇi śīrṣā parā vark
